CustomField.description: Assembled from platform-managed schedule fields with a failsafe for pre-activation commitments — when `ScheduleType` is set but `CurrentGiftCmtScheduleId` is null, returns "Schedule starts in the future."
CustomField.formula: IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(ScheduleType))), ISBLANK(TEXT(CurrentGiftCmtSchedule.TransactionPeriod))), "Schedule starts in the future — this commitment's schedule has not activated yet. A full preview will render once the first scheduled payment date arrives and the platform sets the current schedule on this commitment.", "Schedule preview: " & CASE(TEXT(FQS_Gift_Commitment_Category__c), "Recurring Gift", "The donor will give ", "Pledged Gift", "The donor pledges ", "Grant Payout", "The funder will pay ", "The donor commits to " ) & IF(TEXT(ScheduleType) = "Custom", "$" & TEXT(ExpectedTotalCmtAmount) & " total on a custom payment schedule starting " & CASE(MONTH(EffectiveStartDate),1,"Jan",2,"Feb",3,"Mar",4,"Apr",5,"May",6,"Jun",7,"Jul",8,"Aug",9,"Sep",10,"Oct",11,"Nov",12,"Dec","") & " " & TEXT(DAY(EffectiveStartDate)) & ", " & TEXT(YEAR(EffectiveStartDate)) & ".", IF(AND(TEXT(RecurrenceType)="OpenEnded", NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(CurrentGiftCmtSchedule.TransactionPeriod)))), "$" & TEXT(NextTransactionAmount) & " every " & CASE(TEXT(CurrentGiftCmtSchedule.TransactionPeriod), "Monthly","month", "Yearly","year", "Weekly","week", "Daily","day", "Quarterly","quarter", "Semi-Annual","half year", LOWER(TEXT(CurrentGiftCmtSchedule.TransactionPeriod))) & " starting " & CASE(MONTH(EffectiveStartDate),1,"Jan",2,"Feb",3,"Mar",4,"Apr",5,"May",6,"Jun",7,"Jul",8,"Aug",9,"Sep",10,"Oct",11,"Nov",12,"Dec","") & " " & TEXT(DAY(EffectiveStartDate)) & ", " & TEXT(YEAR(EffectiveStartDate)) & ", continuing indefinitely until the donor cancels.", IF(AND(TEXT(RecurrenceType)="FixedLength", NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(CurrentGiftCmtSchedule.TransactionPeriod)))), "$" & TEXT(ExpectedTotalCmtAmount) & " total, giving $" & TEXT(NextTransactionAmount) & " every " & CASE(TEXT(CurrentGiftCmtSchedule.TransactionPeriod), "Monthly","month", "Yearly","year", "Weekly","week", "Daily","day", "Quarterly","quarter", "Semi-Annual","half year", LOWER(TEXT(CurrentGiftCmtSchedule.TransactionPeriod))) & " starting " & CASE(MONTH(EffectiveStartDate),1,"Jan",2,"Feb",3,"Mar",4,"Apr",5,"May",6,"Jun",7,"Jul",8,"Aug",9,"Sep",10,"Oct",11,"Nov",12,"Dec","") & " " & TEXT(DAY(EffectiveStartDate)) & ", " & TEXT(YEAR(EffectiveStartDate)) & IF(NOT(ISBLANK(ExpectedEndDate)), " through " & CASE(MONTH(ExpectedEndDate),1,"Jan",2,"Feb",3,"Mar",4,"Apr",5,"May",6,"Jun",7,"Jul",8,"Aug",9,"Sep",10,"Oct",11,"Nov",12,"Dec","") & " " & TEXT(DAY(ExpectedEndDate)) & ", " & TEXT(YEAR(ExpectedEndDate)), "") & ".", "$" & TEXT(ExpectedTotalCmtAmount) & " on " & CASE(MONTH(EffectiveStartDate),1,"Jan",2,"Feb",3,"Mar",4,"Apr",5,"May",6,"Jun",7,"Jul",8,"Aug",9,"Sep",10,"Oct",11,"Nov",12,"Dec","") & " " & TEXT(DAY(EffectiveStartDate)) & ", " & TEXT(YEAR(EffectiveStartDate)) & " as a single payment." ))))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set automatically. A one-sentence plain-English summary of this commitment's schedule — cadence, amount, and start. Updates as the underlying schedule changes.
CustomField.label: Summary
